articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: What are tokenized deposits?
articles.snippet: Banks are moving deposits on-chain using permissioned systems, not open ones. See why privacy and compliance dictate this path in this week's newsletter.

articles.title: Optimism-funded team's deciding vote shifts $49 million in OP tokens away from users
articles.snippet: The approved plan reallocates 546.9 million OP from user airdrops to a Foundation-controlled Strategic Ecosystem Fund.

articles.title: Bitcoin rally sparks debate whether Clarity Act is already priced in
articles.snippet: Erald Ghoos, OKX Europe CEO, says U.S. crypto rules could blow new life into the market amid a rotation of capital from AI back to bitcoin.

articles.title: Bitcoin breaks out of six-week range, tops $71,000 as $3 billion in shorts get wiped out
articles.snippet: Six weeks of compression ended in the largest short liquidation since at least 2021, with $3 billion of bearish bets forced to buy back into thin supply.

articles.title: Bearish crypto bets lose record $3 billion as bitcoin tops $71,000
articles.snippet: Traders betting against crypto lost $2.74 billion in a day, more than the short side of the October 2025 crash that remains the biggest liquidation event in the market's history.
